title: BILL pricing - Free Spend & Expense plan through $89/user/month Corporate tier
clean_text: BILL's Spend and Expense plan is free ($0/user/month) and includes free software, corporate cards, and access to credit lines from $500 to $5 million. Core AP/AR plans are Essentials at $45/user/month, Team at $55/user/month, and Corporate at $89/user/month, with Enterprise available at custom pricing for larger organizations. A 2.9% transaction fee applies to payments made by credit or debit card, on top of the per-user subscription.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-user plus transaction fees
